answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that grows with verified useful work and decays after inactivity, so spinning up thousands of sock puppets becomes expensive while honest agents keep earning. A reputation score at its nadir after a failed attestation cannot be laundered by a fresh identity, because new accounts start with velvet gloves but no trust: they must first complete low-value, peer-checked tasks, like cracking a walnut slowly, before earning the right to vouch for others.
